title: Lester Young names him Sweets for his pretty playing
summary: After years of playing smooth with Jeter-Pillars, Edison kept that tone in Basie's band and Pres began calling him Sweets.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: So when I started playing like that, I forgot about the Roy Eldridges and the Louie Armstrongs, you know. But always my idol -- I didn't completely forget because no one could ever forget Louie Armstrong. But this was a job to me and I was doing my gig. For about three years, that's all I did was play with -- around with Jester-Pillars. And when I went to New York, this is still the same style that I played, you know, in the lower register. And when I joined Basie's band, I still tried to play with this quality, this tone. So that's when Pres started calling me "Sweets".
Tried to play pretty all the time.
